text:
morgan: Heads up — eu-west1 embeddings are seeing a spike of 503s (~22:00 UTC). I prepared a restartless hotfix (v1.2.4) that addresses a KV-cache eviction race. Requesting expedited approval for today’s change window (22:10-22:30 UTC).

deploy-bot: /deploy request created: repo=rl-inference, ref=hotfix/kv-evict-1.2.4, env=eu-west1, strategy=restartless-canary. Deploy ID DBOT-9987.

tia: Can you paste the rollback checklist and the exact gating thresholds? ops needs the runbook before we sign off.

sre-oncall: Quick risk summary: functional change is tiny, regression risk low. Operational risk: cache warmup could spike p99 until prefix caches stabilize. Immediate rollback plan: pin traffic back to v1.2.2 + force-kv-clear job if errors > threshold.

alex: I can approve expedited from product side if ops signs off. +1 pending runbook.

emily: Canary proposal: 1% for 15m, look at p99 latency and error-rate; if stable, 10% for 10m -> 100%. Auto-fallback if error-rate > 3% or p99 > 800ms.

release-manager: Draft release note: "fix: embeddings 503 in eu-west1 due to kv cache eviction race (v1.2.4)" — internal preview: https://redwood-internal/release/1.2.4 (please review).

morgan: Runbook and dashboard added: https://runbooks/kv-evict-1.2.4 and https://metrics/redwood/embeddings?env=eu-west1. Rollback command in runbook and a force-clear job: `kubectl run clear-kv --image=ops/kvclear:stable -- env=eu-west1`.

deploy-bot: Proposed canary config: 1% / 15m -> 10% / 10m -> promote. Fallback: immediate pin to v1.2.2 on >3% errors or p99 > 800ms sustained for 5m. Schedule attempt: 2025-11-12T22:10:00Z (inside approved change window).

morgan: Command to invoke (ops):\n```\ndeploybot run DBOT-9987 --canary 1,10 --stabilize 15m,10m --fallback-tag v1.2.2\n```\n
tia: Verified runbook steps and rollback commands. Ops checklist: monitoring alert hooks, pager duty escalation, and traffic pin playbook confirmed.

alex: Approved. :+1:

sre-oncall: I’m on pager and will monitor dashboards during the rollout. If I see p99 > 800ms or errors > 3%, I’ll trigger pin and post a rollback intent here.

emily: tagging platform-ops to stand by for traffic steering ops @platform-ops.

platform-ops: Standing by. We’ll be ready to pin and re-route traffic if needed.

deploy-bot: T-minus 7m until scheduled start. Any objections?

morgan: none from my side. proceeding.

deploy-bot: STARTED DBOT-9987 — rolling hotfix to canary (1%). Status: https://deploys/dbot/9987/status

deploy-bot: CANARY CHECK (5m): errors 0.6% (baseline 0.2%), p99 +120ms. Metrics within gates.

morgan: logs look normal, no new stack traces.

sre-oncall: Monitoring — still inside accept. continuing.

deploy-bot: PROMOTING to 10% after successful canary window.

deploy-bot: 10% running — observing for 10m.

emily: watching traffic steering, no complaints from customers yet.

sre-oncall: p99 trending down, errors stable at 0.8%. safe to promote to 100% once timer completes.

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: v1.2.4 at 100% in eu-west1. Auto-fallback not required. Full status & audit: https://deploys/dbot/9987/audit

release-manager: Release note published to the changelog and internal slack channel. Prod tag: v1.2.4.

morgan: Thanks everyone — closing thread.

alex: great work, fast turnaround. :tada:

sre-oncall: Closing monitoring loop now. Will reopen if regressions appear.
